mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 metabolism of bumetanide and may cause hypokalemia through diuretic effects, while bumetanide can alter electrolytes affecting antiepileptic efficacy.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (especially potassium), renal function, and antiepileptic efficacy; consider potassium supplementation or alternative diuretic; adjust bumetanide dose if needed.
